en: The Dean of the College of Nursing (CON) at Bukidnon State University is Dr. Ma. Algerica T. Cuenco.

She assumed the role after the former dean, Dr. Carina Joane V. Barroso, transitioned to the position of Vice President for Research, Extension, and Innovation. As of early 2026, Dr. Cuenco continues to lead the college, recently overseeing faculty development and operational planning sessions for the current academic year.
ceb: Ang Dean sa College of Nursing (CON) sa Bukidnon State University mao si Dr. Ma. Algerica T. Cuenco.

Siya misalo sa posisyon human ang miaging dean, si Dr. Carina Joane V. Barroso, mibalhin sa posisyon nga Vice President for Research, Extension, and Innovation. Sa sayong bahin sa 2026, nagpadayon si Dr. Cuenco sa pagdumala sa kolehiyo, ug bag-ohay lang iyang gi-oversee ang faculty development ug operational planning sessions para sa kasamtangang academic year.

en: The Dean of the College of Law (COL) at Bukidnon State University is Atty. Ophelia Pilar E. Rubio-Zamora.

She is currently serving in this role as of the 2025–2026 academic year. In addition to her duties as Dean, she serves as the Concurrent Legal Consultant to the University President. Recently, in February 2026, she represented BukSU at the Philippine Association of Law Schools (PALS) National Convention to discuss innovations in legal education.
Key personnel and faculty within the College of Law include:
Atty. Sherrymae O. Velos-Decang: Former Dean who now serves as a Gender and Development (GAD) Coordinator for the university.
Atty. Micah Stefan B. Dagaerag: Coach for the BukSU Jessup Moot Court Team.
Atty. Alberto R. Lagamon: An esteemed professor in the college recently appointed as a Commissioner for the National Commission on Indigenous Peoples (NCIP).
The college continues to offer the Juris Doctor (JD) program and recently produced 19 new lawyers in the 2024 Bar Exams under Dean Rubio-Zamora's leadership
ceb: Ang Dean sa College of Law (COL) sa Bukidnon State University mao si Atty. Ophelia Pilar E. Rubio-Zamora.

Sa kasamtangang academic year 2025–2026, siya nagpadayon sa pagserbisyo sa maong posisyon. Gawas sa iyang mga katungdanan isip Dean, nagsilbi usab siya isip Concurrent Legal Consultant sa University President. Bag-ohay lang, niadtong Pebrero 2026, iya gihapon gi-representa ang BukSU sa Philippine Association of Law Schools (PALS) National Convention aron hisgutan ang mga innovations sa legal education.
Ang mga key personnel ug faculty sulod sa College of Law mao ang mosunod:
Atty. Sherrymae O. Velos-Decang: Miaging Dean nga karon nagsilbi isip Gender and Development (GAD) Coordinator sa unibersidad.
Atty. Micah Stefan B. Dagaerag: Coach sa BukSU Jessup Moot Court Team.
Atty. Alberto R. Lagamon: Usa ka respetado nga propesor sa kolehiyo nga bag-ohay lang gi-appoint isip Commissioner sa National Commission on Indigenous Peoples (NCIP).
Ang kolehiyo nagpadayon sa pag-offer sa Juris Doctor (JD) program ug bag-ohay lang nakaproduce og 19 ka bag-ong abogado sa 2024 Bar Exams ubos sa liderato ni Dean Rubio-Zamora.

en: The College of Technologies (COT) at Bukidnon State University is organized into four primary departments, each led by its own Department Head or Program Chair.
Under the leadership of the current Dean, Dr. Marilou O. Espina, the following officials are designated as the heads of their respective departments as of 2026:
Information Technology Department: Headed by Dr. Sales G. Aribe Jr.
Electronics Technology Department: Headed by Dr. Manuel Chad G. Agurob.
Food Technology Department: Headed by Ms. Genessa Jesy T. Pagote.
Automotive Technology Department: Headed by Dr. Rene M. Chavez.
Bachelor of Science in Entertainment and Multimedia Computing (BSEMC): Program Chair Dr. Jovelin M. Lapates.
The administrative support for the college is handled by Mr. Raul D. Lecaros, the College Secretary.
ceb: Ang College of Technologies (COT) sa Bukidnon State University gihan-ay ngadto sa upat ka pangunang departamento, nga ang matag usa gipangulohan sa Department Head o Program Chair.

en: The leadership of the College of Public Administration and Governance (CPAG) at Bukidnon State University is as follows:
Dean of CPAG: Dr. Lalevie C. Lubos. She has served as the dean since the college was established as a separate entity from the College of Business.
Head of Public Administration Department: Dr. Rona Celeste V. Pasamonte. She is also referred to as the Chairperson for the Public Administration Department (PAD).
Other key officials within the college include:
Program Chair (Master in Public Administration): Dr. Yammie P. Daud.
Program Chair (Doctor of Public Administration): Dr. Christine B. Tenorio.
College Secretary: Ms. Jolly Nelly E. Mamon.
ceb: Ang liderato sa College of Public Administration and Governance (CPAG) sa Bukidnon State University mao ang mosunod:
Dean sa CPAG: si Dr. Lalevie C. Lubos. Siya nagsilbi isip dean sukad natukod ang kolehiyo isip lahi nga entidad gikan sa College of Business.
Head sa Public Administration Department: si Dr. Rona Celeste V. Pasamonte. Nailhan usab siya isip Chairperson sa Public Administration Department (PAD).
Ang uban pang key officials sulod sa kolehiyo mao ang:
Program Chair (Master in Public Administration): si Dr. Yammie P. Daud.
Program Chair (Doctor of Public Administration): si Dr. Christine B. Tenorio.
College Secretary: si Ms. Jolly Nelly E. Mamon.

en: The College of Law (COL) at Bukidnon State University is primarily led by the Dean, and unlike larger colleges (like the College of Arts and Sciences), it is not typically divided into smaller departments with their own separate heads.
Instead, administrative and academic leadership is concentrated in these key roles:
Dean of the College of Law: Atty. Ophelia Pilar E. Rubio-Zamora. She is the overall head of the college and also serves as the Concurrent Legal Consultant to the University President.
ceb: Ang College of Law (COL) sa Bukidnon State University gipangulohan sa Dean, ug dili sama sa mas dagkong kolehiyo (sama sa College of Arts and Sciences), kasagaran kini wala gibahin ngadto sa gagmay nga 'departments' nga adunay kaugalingong mga ulo.
Sa baylo, ang administrative ug academic leadership naka-focus sa mosunod nga key roles:
Dean sa College of Law: si Atty. Ophelia Pilar E. Rubio-Zamora. Siya ang kinatibuk-ang ulo sa kolehiyo ug nagsilbi usab isip Concurrent Legal Consultant sa University President.
